data.content: PLAN_REVIEW PASS by Codex. Design decision: Option A is required. Gemini/agy must fail closed for BOTH read-only and read-only-with-artifacts because bba8 proves --sandbox is not a write boundary and there is no native no-edit primitive. Implement provider-entry refusal in gemini-cli-provider.ts at doComplete and doStreamComplete before ensureBinary()/spawn so restricted gemini fails without requiring auth/binary startup. Use a clear non-retryable LLMProviderError code RESTRICTED_MODE_UNSUPPORTED and an honest message directing callers to codex/cursor/API providers. Drop --sandbox from the restricted branch defensively; restricted buildCliArgs must emit neither --sandbox nor --dangerously-skip-permissions. Tests must assert complete() and streamComplete() reject/yield the refusal for both restricted modes, no child spawn occurs for those calls, full mode remains unchanged, and existing codex/cursor confinement behavior is untouched. Bridge pre-refusal is not required unless implementation proves provider-error propagation is not clean; if added, keep it consistent with the provider error and test it.
